name: Research
description: Delegates a research question to a background agent that reads primary sources and writes a cited Markdown findings file into the repo.
longDescription: A three-step prompt that hands reading legwork to a **background agent** so the main session keeps working. The agent investigates the question against primary sources only (official docs, source code, specs, first-party APIs), following every claim back to the source that owns it rather than a secondary write-up; writes the findings to a single `.md` file citing each claim's source; and saves it where the repo already keeps such notes, or somewhere sensible and says where. Assumes `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` ran once in the repo.
